modules.title: Introduction to Hadith and Sunnah
modules.html:
The meaning of Hadith and Sunnah, their compilation, classification and importance as a source of Islamic law and guidance. This section covers introduction to hadith and sunnah.

Key points

  • A Hadith that is attributed directly to Allah but phrased by the Prophet (SAW) is called _____. — Hadith Qudsi.
  • Which of the following is NOT among the 'As-Sihah as-Sittah' (The Six Authentic Books of Hadith) — Muwatta Malik.
  • The Prophet's wife who was the daughter of Abu Bakr and a great scholar of Hadith was _____. — Aishah.
  • A Hadith that has a broken chain of narrators is classified as _____. — Munqati'.
  • The compiler of the most authentic book of Hadith, Sahih Al-Bukhari, was from _____. — Uzbekistan (Bukhara).

Worked examples

Q: A Hadith that is attributed directly to Allah but phrased by the Prophet (SAW) is called _____.
A: Hadith Qudsi — Hadith Qudsi (Sacred Hadith) contains meanings from Allah expressed in the Prophet's words, distinguished from the Qur'an which is Allah's literal word.

Q: Which of the following is NOT among the 'As-Sihah as-Sittah' (The Six Authentic Books of Hadith)?
A: Muwatta Malik — Muwatta Malik is a highly respected collection but is not traditionally numbered among the 'Six Books' (Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Nasa'i, and Ibn Majah).

quiz.q: A Hadith that is attributed directly to Allah but phrased by the Prophet (SAW) is called _____.
quiz.solution: Hadith Qudsi (Sacred Hadith) contains meanings from Allah expressed in the Prophet's words, distinguished from the Qur'an which is Allah's literal word.

quiz.q: Which of the following is NOT among the 'As-Sihah as-Sittah' (The Six Authentic Books of Hadith)?
quiz.solution: Muwatta Malik is a highly respected collection but is not traditionally numbered among the 'Six Books' (Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Nasa'i, and Ibn Majah).

quiz.q: The Prophet's wife who was the daughter of Abu Bakr and a great scholar of Hadith was _____.
quiz.solution: Aishah (RA) was known for her intelligence and contributed significantly to the preservation and teaching of Islamic knowledge.

quiz.q: A Hadith that has a broken chain of narrators is classified as _____.
quiz.solution: Munqati' refers to a Hadith where a narrator is missing from the chain of transmission.

quiz.q: The compiler of the most authentic book of Hadith, Sahih Al-Bukhari, was from _____.
quiz.solution: Imam Muhammad b. Ismail al-Bukhari was born in Bukhara, in present-day Uzbekistan.

quiz.q: A Hadith narrated by only one person at every stage of the chain is called _____.
quiz.solution: Gharib means 'strange' or 'solitary' in Hadith terminology.

quiz.q: The science of judging the character of Hadith narrators is _____.
quiz.solution: Ilm al-Rijal (Science of Men) involves investigating the biographies and credibility of Hadith narrators.
